method: Each entry below was looked up at the issuing body's own catalogue or legislative portal (IAEA, ISO, IEC, ASME, WENRA, EUR-Lex, gov.uk, Stuklex, PIB India) on 2026-08-12, and the designation, title, issuing body and current status were read off that page. The register names documents without an edition and says so, so what is graded is whether the designation is live at the issuing body and whether number, title and body agree. Entries whose issuing body could not be reached are recorded as unverified and flagged, never guessed — the register's own limitations already disclose that the Indian layer is single-sourced for this reason.
